classicbar.config.bars.health.icon.toolt: ClassicBar icon resource for the health overlay. Must stay inside classicbar:textures/gui/icons/*.png.
classicbar.config.bars.health.mode.toolt: Health and absorption share vanilla PLAYER_HEALTH. If there are no absorption hearts to preserve, Health OVERRIDE still hides vanilla hearts. If visible absorption hearts are present, ClassicBar only cancels PLAYER_HEALTH when both shared bars are OVERRIDE, active in layout, and currently rendering; otherwise the whole vanilla player health layer stays visible to preserve health and absorption info.
classicbar.config.bars.health.color_over: #RRGGBB replaces all fill passes for this bar, which can hide gradients and layered fills. #AARRGGBB alpha-blends with the original fill colors instead of changing render transparency, and health effect overlays can still render on top.
classicbar.config.bars.health.text_forma: Controls how the health value is displayed. current_only: 12, current_max: 12 / 20, percent_max: 60% / 20.
classicbar.config.bars.armor.show_text.t: Render the numeric armor value next to the armor bar.

classicbar.config.bars.armor.mode.toolti: OVERRIDE hides vanilla armor, DISABLED turns off the ClassicBar armor overlay.
classicbar.config.bars.armor.color_overl: #RRGGBB replaces all fill passes for this bar, which can hide gradient detail. #AARRGGBB alpha-blends with the original fill colors instead of changing render transparency.
classicbar.config.bars.armor.text_format: Controls how the armor value is displayed. current_only: 12, current_max: 12 / 20, percent_max: 60% / 20.

classicbar.config.bars.absorption.icon.t: ClassicBar icon resource for the absorption overlay. Must stay inside classicbar:textures/gui/icons/*.png.
classicbar.config.bars.absorption.mode.t: Absorption also shares vanilla PLAYER_HEALTH with health. If there are no visible absorption hearts, Health OVERRIDE can still hide vanilla hearts on its own. When visible absorption hearts are present, ClassicBar only cancels PLAYER_HEALTH if both health and absorption are OVERRIDE, active in layout, and currently rendering; DISABLED, or layout removal keeps the whole vanilla player health layer visible.
classicbar.config.bars.absorption.color_: #RRGGBB replaces all fill passes for this bar, which can hide gradients and layered absorption fills. #AARRGGBB alpha-blends with the original fill colors instead of changing render transparency.
classicbar.config.bars.absorption.text_f: Controls how the absorption value is displayed. current_only: 12, current_max: 12 / 20, percent_max: 60% / 20.

classicbar.config.bars.food.color_overla: #RRGGBB replaces all fill passes for this bar, including the saturation pass, which can hide vanilla-style layering. #AARRGGBB alpha-blends with the original fill colors instead of changing render transparency.
